meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断基因调控网络
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析RNA-seq数据并寻找转录因子与靶基因的调控关系。
copy.tagline_en: Infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing RNA-seq data to find transcription factor-target gene relationships.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据基因表达数据推断基因调控网络，找出哪些转录因子调控哪些靶基因，并给出调控重要性评分。
howto.when: 当你提供基因表达矩阵（如 RNA-seq 数据）并请求分析转录调控关系时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GRNBoost2 从这份单细胞表达数据中推断基因调控网络。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data, identifying which transcription factors regulate which target genes and providing regulatory importance scores.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a gene expression matrix (e.g., RNA-seq data) and request analysis of transcriptional regulatory relationships.

say_en.text: Run GRNBoost2 on this single-cell expression data to infer a gene regulatory network.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the grnboost2 algorithm and output results.

say_en.text: For this expression matrix, consider only the TFs in the list, run GRNBoost2 with seed 777.
say_en.note: Claude will load the TF list and perform inference with the specified seed.
